extension.summary: Gives subtitle add-ons the movie hash of streamed videos
extension.description: When a video starts, computes its OpenSubtitles movie hash (file size + first and last 64 KiB) through Kodi's own file reader, so it also works for http streams (Elementum, debrid, other plugins). Publishes it on the Home window as videoinfo.current_path / current_size / current_oshash, which OpenSubtitles.com, SubSource and SubDL already read. When the playing video lacks metadata, asks OpenSubtitles.com for an exact movie-hash match and fills in only the EMPTY fields (IMDb and TMDb id, title, year, type, show/season/episode) - nothing already set is overwritten - so subtitle add-ons that need an IMDb id (a4kSubtitles) can search and the player shows a real title.
